# Getting Started with MarkDraft

MarkDraft is a *Markdown* reader and writer. This paragraph has **strong text**,
_emphasis_, ***both at once***, ~~strikethrough~~ and `inline code`. Intra-word
emphasis like un*frigging*believable works too.

A second paragraph with a [link to the website](https://example.com "Title") and
an autolink: https://github.com/markdraft/markdraft. Email autolinks such as
<hello@example.com> become `mailto:` links.
